photo_note: Photos are Wikimedia Commons thumbnails (hotlinked) with author and licence shown, or owner-supplied uploads in /assets/images with written permission. Never copy photos or data from other location databases; record only what a venue itself publishes, and keep source URLs.

locations.name: Salzburg Old Town
locations.setting: Baroque old town of church domes, squares and narrow lanes beneath the Hohensalzburg fortress on the Salzach river.

locations.name: Schönbrunn Palace
locations.setting: Baroque imperial summer palace with more than 1,400 rooms, formal gardens, the Gloriette hilltop folly and a historic zoo.

locations.name: Sölden
locations.setting: High Alpine ski resort village in the Ötztal valley with glacier roads climbing to 2,800 metres and a summit restaurant at 3,048 metres.

locations.name: Bruges Historic Centre
locations.setting: Intact medieval city centre of canals, cobbled streets, stepped-gable brick houses and the towering thirteenth-century Belfry.

locations.name: Gravensteen
locations.setting: Moated twelfth-century stone castle with towers, battlements and a gatehouse standing in the middle of Ghent.

locations.name: Lites Studios
locations.setting: Modern studio complex near Brussels with five stages, including Europe's largest heated indoor water tank for underwater filming.

locations.name: Dubrovnik Old Town
locations.setting: Walled seaside old town with intact medieval ramparts, baroque stone streets and fortresses rising straight from the Adriatic.
locations.known_for: Game of Thrones (King's Landing, from season 2), Star Wars: The Last Jedi (2017), Robin Hood (2018)

locations.name: Jadran Film
locations.setting: Film studio founded in 1946 with stages and backlot grounds in Zagreb's Dubrava district, host to well over a hundred international co-productions.
locations.known_for: Winnetou series (1962-1968), The Tin Drum (1979), Sophie's Choice (1982)

locations.name: Plitvice Lakes National Park
locations.setting: Chain of sixteen terraced turquoise lakes linked by waterfalls in a forested karst canyon.
locations.known_for: Treasure of the Silver Lake (1962), Karl May Winnetou westerns (1962-1968)

locations.name: Archbishop's Palace, Kroměříž
locations.setting: UNESCO-listed baroque archbishop's palace with opulent state rooms and formal gardens that have stood in for imperial Vienna.

locations.name: Barrandov Studios
locations.setting: Prague studio complex dating from the early 1930s with large sound stages, extensive costume and prop stocks and backlot space.

locations.name: Český Krumlov
locations.setting: Renaissance and baroque town wrapped in a tight bend of the Vltava river beneath a painted castle tower.
locations.known_for: The Adventures of Pinocchio (1996), Hostel (2005), The Illusionist (2006)

locations.name: Christiansborg Palace
locations.setting: Government palace on the Slotsholmen islet housing the Danish Parliament, Prime Minister's Office and Supreme Court, with a riding ground complex and palace square.

locations.name: Kronborg Castle
locations.setting: Renaissance fortress at the narrowest point of the Øresund strait, with ramparts, a large courtyard and vaulted casemates, known as the Elsinore of Shakespeare's Hamlet.

locations.name: Nordisk Film Studios
locations.setting: Working studio lot in Valby founded in 1906, the world's oldest continuously active film studio, with shooting stages, post-production facilities and a 360-degree LED stage.

locations.name: Ivalo
locations.setting: Village on the Ivalo River about 250 kilometres north of the Arctic Circle, surrounded by boreal forest and fells, with deep snow and polar night for much of the year.

locations.name: Mediapolis
locations.setting: Media campus at broadcaster Yle's Tohloppi site in Tampere, with fully equipped television studios and a 1,500 square metre factory hall stage available for hire.

locations.name: Senate Square
locations.setting: Neoclassical square by Carl Ludvig Engel framed by Helsinki Cathedral, the Government Palace and the university, long used as a stand-in for imperial St Petersburg and Soviet-era Moscow.

locations.name: Cité du Cinéma (Studios de Paris)
locations.setting: Studio campus in a converted riverside power station with sound stages, workshops and offices around a monumental glass-roofed nave.
locations.known_for: Lucy, Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets

locations.name: Palace of Versailles
locations.setting: Baroque royal palace with the Hall of Mirrors, state apartments, vast formal gardens and two smaller palaces in the park.

locations.name: Étretat Cliffs
locations.setting: White chalk cliffs with natural arches and a freestanding needle rising above a pebble beach on the Alabaster Coast.

locations.name: Görlitz Old Town
locations.setting: War-spared old town of around 4,000 listed buildings ranging from Gothic and Renaissance to Baroque and Wilhelminian styles.
locations.known_for: The Grand Budapest Hotel, Inglourious Basterds, The Reader

locations.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
locations.setting: Nineteenth-century Romanesque revival castle rising from a wooded Alpine crag above the village of Hohenschwangau.
locations.known_for: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang, The Great Escape, Ludwig (1973)

locations.name: Studio Babelsberg
locations.setting: The world's oldest large-scale film studio, in operation since 1912, with sound stages, workshops and permanent backlot sets.
locations.known_for: Metropolis, Inglourious Basterds, Bridge of Spies

locations.name: Meteora
locations.setting: Byzantine monasteries perched on sheer sandstone rock pillars rising above the Thessalian plain.

locations.name: Nu Boyana Hellenic Film Studios
locations.setting: Purpose-built studio complex near Thessaloniki airport with eight sound stages totalling about 15,000 square metres and a 25,000 square metre backlot.

locations.name: Skopelos
locations.setting: Pine-fringed Aegean island with pebble coves, a whitewashed harbour town and the clifftop chapel of Agios Ioannis.

locations.name: Hungarian State Opera House
locations.setting: Miklós Ybl's neo-Renaissance opera house of 1884 on Andrássy Avenue, with a gilded horseshoe auditorium, marble staircases and an arcaded stone facade.

locations.name: Origo Studios
locations.setting: Purpose-built studio complex in Budapest with eleven stages, including nine soundstages and around 19,000 square metres of filming space, plus backlot areas and underwater filming facilities.

locations.name: Vajdahunyad Castle
locations.setting: Eclectic replica castle of 1896 on a lake island in Budapest's City Park, combining Romanesque, Gothic, Renaissance and Baroque wings within a few hundred metres.

locations.name: RVK Studios
locations.setting: Around 8,000 square metres of stages in a converted fertiliser plant at Gufunes, with three large studios a short drive from downtown Reykjavík.

locations.name: Reynisfjara
locations.setting: Black volcanic sand beach near Vík with hexagonal basalt columns, the Reynisdrangar sea stacks offshore and powerful Atlantic surf.
locations.known_for: Noah (2014), Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)

locations.name: Svínafellsjökull
locations.setting: Heavily crevassed outlet glacier of Vatnajökull ending in a small lagoon, reachable in minutes from the Ring Road inside Vatnajökull National Park.

locations.name: Ardmore Studios
locations.setting: Ireland's longest-established film studios, offering sound stages, workshops and production offices on an 18-acre site in Bray.

locations.name: Kilmainham Gaol
locations.setting: Preserved nineteenth-century prison with a galleried Victorian east wing, stone corridors and bare exercise yards, now a museum.
locations.known_for: The Italian Job (1969), In the Name of the Father, Paddington 2

locations.name: Skellig Michael
locations.setting: Steep rocky island in the Atlantic off the Kerry coast, topped by a sixth-century monastic settlement of stone beehive huts.
locations.known_for: Star Wars: The Force Awakens, Star Wars: The Last Jedi

locations.name: Cinecittà
locations.setting: Historic Rome studio complex founded in 1937, with sound stages including the vast Teatro 5 and permanent backlot sets such as ancient Rome.
locations.known_for: Ben-Hur (1959), La Dolce Vita (1960), Rome (2005-2007, HBO/BBC)

locations.name: Sassi di Matera
locations.setting: Ancient cave-dwelling districts carved into a limestone ravine, frequently standing in for biblical-era Jerusalem.
locations.known_for: The Passion of the Christ (2004), Wonder Woman (2017), No Time to Die (2021)

locations.name: Villa del Balbianello
locations.setting: Eighteenth-century villa on a wooded promontory of Lake Como with terraced gardens and open lake panoramas, now a FAI heritage property.
locations.known_for: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (2002), Casino Royale (2006)

locations.name: Fort Ricasoli
locations.setting: Vast 17th-century bastioned fort at the mouth of the Grand Harbour whose open parade grounds host large-scale open-air set builds.

locations.name: Malta Film Studios
locations.setting: State-run studio facility whose two vast exterior water tanks sit on the shoreline so their surfaces blend into the natural sea horizon, complemented by an indoor insert tank.
locations.known_for: Raise the Titanic (1980), U-571 (2000), Captain Phillips (2013)

locations.name: Mdina
locations.setting: Walled medieval hilltop city of narrow honey-coloured limestone streets, baroque palaces and a monumental main gate.

locations.name: Amsterdam Canal Ring
locations.setting: Seventeenth-century ring of tree-lined canals with gabled townhouses, humpback bridges and houseboats.
locations.known_for: The Fault in Our Stars, Ocean's Twelve

locations.name: Erasmusbrug
locations.setting: Asymmetric cable-stayed bridge with a 139-metre bent steel pylon spanning the Nieuwe Maas against the Rotterdam skyline.

locations.name: Media Park Hilversum
locations.setting: Television production campus in Hilversum with large audience studios such as Studio 21 and 22 and most national broadcasters on site.
locations.known_for: The Voice of Holland, The Voice Kids

locations.name: Atlantic Ocean Road
locations.setting: Eight-kilometre stretch of County Road 64 hopping between skerries on a chain of bridges, including the curved Storseisundet Bridge, exposed to open sea on both sides.

locations.name: Dagslys Studios
locations.setting: Five purpose-built stages from 81 to 500 square metres in Nydalen, Oslo, with lighting and grip rental, workshops, props storage and costume and makeup rooms in the same building.

locations.name: Preikestolen (Pulpit Rock)
locations.setting: Flat granite cliff ledge about 600 metres above Lysefjord, reached only by a four-kilometre mountain hiking trail.

locations.name: ATM Studio
locations.setting: Film and television production centre of around 14,000 square metres in Warsaw's Wawer district, with multiple soundstages, TV studios, production offices and post-production facilities.
locations.known_for: The Voice of Poland, Dancing with the Stars: Taniec z gwiazdami

locations.name: Kazimierz, Kraków
locations.setting: Kraków's former Jewish quarter, where synagogues, cobbled lanes and tenement courtyards still follow the pre-war street layout.

locations.name: Ogrodzieniec Castle
locations.setting: Ruined 14th-century castle on the highest hill of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, its broken towers rising among limestone outcrops on the Trail of the Eagles' Nests.

locations.name: Alfama
locations.setting: Lisbon's oldest quarter, a hillside maze of steep cobbled lanes, tiled facades and tram lines above the Tagus.

locations.name: Convento de Cristo
locations.setting: Templar castle and convent complex crowned by the round Charola oratory, with Manueline cloisters and hilltop ramparts above Tomar.
locations.known_for: The Man Who Killed Don Quixote (2018)

locations.name: Praia do Guincho
locations.setting: Wide Atlantic surf beach backed by dunes and the Sintra hills, known for strong wind and heavy waves.

locations.name: Ciudad de la Luz
locations.setting: Purpose-built studio complex beside the Mediterranean on the edge of Alicante, with large sound stages, exterior water tanks and production support buildings, reopened to shoots in 2022.
locations.known_for: Asterix at the Olympic Games (2008), The Impossible (2012)

locations.name: Real Alcázar of Seville
locations.setting: Mudéjar royal palace complex in central Seville with tiled courtyards, arched ceremonial halls and lush formal gardens.
locations.known_for: Lawrence of Arabia (1962), Kingdom of Heaven (2005), Game of Thrones (season 5, Dorne)

photo.author: Ajay Suresh from New York, NY, USA. Edited by MenkinAlRire

locations.name: Tabernas Desert
locations.setting: Europe's only true desert, with eroded badlands, dry riverbeds and surviving western town sets from the spaghetti-western era.
locations.known_for: Lawrence of Arabia (1962), The Good, the Bad and the Ugly (1966), Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)

locations.name: Film i Väst
locations.setting: Regional film fund and studio base in Trollhättan, nicknamed Trollywood, whose stages and industrial halls have held full-scale purpose-built sets.

locations.name: Fårö
locations.setting: Small Baltic island north of Gotland with limestone rauk stacks, shingle shores and windswept heathland, where Ingmar Bergman lived and filmed for decades.
locations.known_for: Persona (1966), Through a Glass Darkly (1961), Scenes from a Marriage (1973)

locations.name: Ystad
locations.setting: Medieval coastal town with half-timbered houses, cobbled streets and a sandy Baltic shoreline, home to the Ystad Studios film facility.

locations.name: Freshwater West
locations.setting: Wide Atlantic surf beach backed by dunes and low cliffs on the open Pembrokeshire coast.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1, Robin Hood (2010), Their Finest

locations.name: Glenfinnan Viaduct
locations.setting: Curved 21-arch concrete railway viaduct of 1901 carrying the West Highland Line above the head of Loch Shiel.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets, Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

locations.name: Pinewood Studios
locations.setting: Major studio complex west of London whose facilities include large sound stages, the vast 007 Stage, backlots and an underwater filming tank.
locations.known_for: No Time to Die, Star Wars: The Force Awakens
